channel.title: Cenk Kurtoğlu — Digital Product Releases
channel.description: Verified apps, AI automation, downloadable kits, and editable source products by Cenk Kurtoğlu.

item.title: Free Guide: How to Do a Website Audit for a Client
item.description: A practical process for auditing a client's website: scoping the boundary, collecting evidence, scoring with published rules, reporting for two readers, and pricing the engagement. Free guide; the paid $49 Audit Kit is disclosed, not required.

item.title: Free Guide: llms.txt Explained — Do You Need One, and How to Create It
item.description: What llms.txt actually is, what publishing one does and does not do, a decision framework, three creation paths, and a publishing checklist. Free guide; the paid Apify generator is disclosed, not required.

item.title: Free Evidence-Led Website Scorecard — 12 Checks, 100 Points
item.description: A free browser-only scorecard with 12 evidence-gated checks totaling 100 points, explicit unknown states, and JSON or Markdown export. No signup, upload, crawl, backend, or saved data. Includes one disclosed link to the $49 AI-Ready Website Audit Kit.

item.title: Free Guide: Build an Evidence-Led Website Audit Without Fake Precision
item.description: A free eight-step method for defining audit scope, assigning evidence IDs, handling unknown states, scoring transparently, and making later reviews comparable. Includes one clearly disclosed link to the $49 AI-Ready Website Audit Kit.

item.title: AI-Ready Website Audit Kit — $49 Evidence-Led Workflow
item.description: A dependency-free Node.js scorer, evidence ledger, 19-page playbook, regression tests, and editable templates for producing a transparent 100-point operational-readiness audit. The weights are author-defined and do not guarantee rankings, AI citations, traffic, or revenue. One-time price: $49 USD.

item.title: Free Next.js + Supabase Production Checklist — 10 Checks
item.description: A free, source-backed field guide covering secrets, RLS, auth redirects, authorization, metadata, production builds, and failure paths before a Next.js and Supabase launch.

item.title: Perde Atölyesi Fiyatlama Pilotu — $249 / 5 Days
item.description: A fixed-scope browser-based pricing pilot for curtain shops in Türkiye. Demo data is illustrative; final formulas and price tables are verified by the customer. Price: $249 USD. Duration: 5 days after written scope and required inputs are complete.

item.title: Next.js + Supabase Launch Checklist — 60 Pre-Launch Checks
item.description: An 8-page, 117 KB PDF with 60 practical checks covering Next.js and Supabase secrets, RLS, authentication, performance, SEO, reliability, and go-live. Educational checklist; not an automated scan or security guarantee. One-time price: $12 USD.

item.title: Abonem — Subscription Tracker for iPhone and iPad
item.description: A free subscription and recurring-bill tracker with optional Premium in-app purchases. Regional pricing is shown by Apple.

item.title: llms.txt Generator — Apify Actor and API Automation
item.description: Generate llms.txt, llms-full.txt, and an exportable page dataset. Public price starts at $5 per 1,000 results.

item.title: SaaS Launch Swipe File
item.description: A downloadable kit with 40+ fill-in launch templates, a seven-day plan, Product Hunt materials, channel-specific copy, and a checklist. One-time price: $19 USD.

item.title: Premium Nexus Studio — Cinematic 3D Next.js Template
item.description: An editable cinematic 3D Next.js studio starting point for agencies and developers. One-time price: $250 USD. Demo names, claims, metrics, awards, and testimonials are placeholders.

item.title: Meridian — Animated Next.js Agency Source
item.description: An animated standalone Next.js agency starting point. One-time price: $100 USD.
